Chat request that includes a developer role message alongside user messages

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var requestJson = "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a coding assistant. Always respond with concise code examples.\",\"role\":\"developer\"},{\"content\":\"How do I reverse a string in Python?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}";
        var request = JsonUtil.fromJson(requestJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(request);
        System.out.println(result.choices());
        System.out.println(result.choices().get(0).message().content());
        System.out.println(result.choices().get(0).finishReason());
        }
    }
}
```
